Hi, I’m Haoyu Tong.

I am currently an undergraduate student majoring in Computer Science at Hongshen Honors School, Chongqing University. My recent research focuses on computer vision, and I am also interested in AI product development.

I am always glad to meet new friends and collaborators. If anything about me interests you, feel free to reach out via email (tohay818@gmail.com). At a time when AI can generate vast amounts of convincing but unreliable information, I believe genuine human connection matters more than ever.
